tickets.problem: Recurring calendar invitations created by the scheduling team arrived one hour early after the daylight-saving change. The desktop calendar showed the wrong time zone for the series.
tickets.resolution: Edited the recurring series in the desktop calendar and set its time zone to Europe/Warsaw. Sent the updated series to attendees.

tickets.problem: After the clocks changed, recurring meeting invitations sent from the mobile calendar appeared one hour early for attendees.
tickets.resolution: Turned off the mobile calendar's fixed time-zone override and enabled the device's automatic time zone. Sent a test invitation and checked the start time.

tickets.problem: A calendar room appeared as unavailable before the daylight-saving change. The invitation times were correct.
tickets.resolution: Removed a duplicate room reservation that was blocking the slot.

tickets.problem: The finance workbook template opened read-only when launched from the department wiki. Staff needed to fill in their own copy.
tickets.resolution: Changed the wiki link to the workbook template's download URL and told staff to open the downloaded copy locally.

tickets.problem: A finance workbook already saved on a shared drive opened read-only because a coworker had it open for editing.
tickets.resolution: Asked the coworker to close the shared workbook and verified that editing became available.

tickets.problem: The agent could hear callers through the new headset, but callers heard silence. The softphone still had the old headset selected as the input device.
tickets.resolution: Selected the new headset's microphone in the softphone input settings and verified audio on a test call.

tickets.problem: Callers heard an echo when the agent answered calls using a desk speaker instead of a headset.
tickets.resolution: Enabled echo cancellation in the softphone and reduced the speaker volume.

tickets.problem: The meeting-room touchscreen shuts down unexpectedly during afternoon sessions. Battery replacement has been proposed but nobody has tested it.
A handheld stocktaking terminal switched off each time its removable battery dropped below 30 percent.
tickets.resolution: Replaced the stocktaking terminal's worn battery and verified that it ran through a full discharge cycle.

tickets.problem: Several accented characters appear as empty squares when a PDF report generated by the reporting workstation is opened on another PC.
tickets.resolution: Enabled font embedding in the reporting application's PDF export settings and regenerated the report.

tickets.problem: The first page appears blank whenever a PDF report is printed from the lobby kiosk. It looks correct on screen.
tickets.resolution: Enabled Print as Image in the kiosk's PDF viewer.

tickets.problem: After a macOS update, the shortcut in Finder no longer opened the shared artwork folder. Opening the new SMB address manually worked.
tickets.resolution: Removed the obsolete Finder favorite and added the shared artwork folder from the new SMB address.

tickets.problem: A wireless keyboard misses keystrokes when its USB receiver is plugged directly into the back of a busy USB 3 docking station.
tickets.resolution: Moved the keyboard receiver away from the dock with a short USB extension cable. Keystrokes registered normally during a ten-minute test.

tickets.problem: The warehouse document scanner feeds two pieces of paper together from the automatic feeder, leaving gaps in the scanned PDF.
tickets.resolution: Replaced the worn separation pad and rescanned the batch one page at a time to check the order.

tickets.problem: The same warehouse document scanner pulls two pages at once even after a clean batch of paper is loaded. The separation pad was recently replaced.
tickets.resolution: Recalibrated the document scanner's ultrasonic double-feed sensor using the vendor maintenance utility, then ran a test stack.

tickets.problem: The warehouse document scanner leaves a thin dark vertical line on every page. Its paper feeder takes one sheet at a time.
tickets.resolution: Cleaned the narrow glass strip used by the automatic feeder.

tickets.problem: The shift planner shows duplicate assignments after a supervisor imports the same weekly CSV twice.
tickets.resolution: Removed the duplicate import batch and enabled the importer option to skip rows with an existing assignment ID.

tickets.problem: Overnight uploads to the team drive pause after the transfer window closes. The team is still investigating the retry behavior.
Overnight exports from the billing app stopped because the export service was disabled during maintenance.
tickets.resolution: Re-enabled the billing export service. The next scheduled export completed.

tickets.problem: Supply-order emails stopped appearing in the team mailbox after the former coordinator left. New orders were still being sent to the former coordinator's individual address.
tickets.resolution: Changed the supply form's notification recipient to the team mailbox and submitted a test order.

tickets.problem: The conference badge app says the label size is invalid after a new stock roll is fitted. The physical roll is the correct width.
tickets.resolution: Selected the matching 62 mm label template in the badge app and recalibrated the badge printer's media sensor.

tickets.problem: The presentation editor opens presentations but closes unexpectedly when exporting a deck with embedded video.
tickets.resolution: Installed the media export component and exported the presentation again.

tickets.problem: When a user opens a calendar reminder from the notification area, the window appears on a disconnected second screen and cannot be reached.
tickets.resolution: Reset the calendar application's saved window position and reopened the reminder on the primary display.

tickets.problem: The warehouse kiosk loads an outdated safety checklist even though other PCs show the revised page.
tickets.resolution: Cleared the kiosk browser's cached site data and replaced its bookmark with the current checklist URL.

tickets.problem: The cafeteria payment terminal repeatedly displayed a blank receipt screen. The cause of the issue was never established.
tickets.resolution: Restarted the payment application, which returned the receipt screen to normal. No root cause was confirmed.

tickets.problem: The expense receipt upload finishes immediately without saving large photos, while small images are accepted.
tickets.resolution: Exported the receipt photos as JPEGs below the expense app's 5 MB upload limit and submitted them again.

tickets.problem: The time clock kiosk's touchscreen registers taps one row below the button the operator touches.
tickets.resolution: Ran the touchscreen calibration from Windows Tablet PC Settings and checked all four corners of the display.

tickets.problem: The conference room desk phone could not make outgoing calls after a handset replacement. Incoming calls still worked.
tickets.resolution: Assigned the replacement handset the conference room's outbound dialing profile.
